correctness.rationale: For positive terminal sink rates the no-capture norm decreases and the only nondecaying subspace is the span of Hermitian adjacency eigenvectors vanishing at both terminals; all other finite-dimensional modes have strictly negative damping, even with Jordan blocks. Dirichlet path sine modes have distinct rational frequencies t=k/L. Endpoint cancellation splits resonant modes by parity and removes one dimension per nonempty group. For three paths, compatible pair counts minus triple overlap yields the exact gcd/parity formula. The coefficient-space orthogonal projector with weights sqrt(2/L_i)sin(pi*t) gives the localized noncapture probability. A direct independently written full adjacency eigenspace/sink-evaluation reconstruction matched both the entire dark projector and gcd dimension for all 125 ordered triples 2≤Li≤6; finite numerics do not replace the exact spectral argument.
residual_risks: Uniform adjacency hopping with equal onsite shifts; three paths and two positive absorbing terminal rates only.
No finite-time transport, disorder, flux or nonuniform hoppings.
